result.notes: I removed other_conditions ('Triggered only by demolition or conversion') and the demolition/conversion wording from the summary. These describe landlord conduct, which is the event trigger already captured by event_only, not the buildings covered. The bulletin (D043) says only that the rule applies to property regardless of RSO or JCO status. It states no unit-count, construction-date, owner or exemption limits, so those fields stay null. requires_unknown_facts is false because the rule covers ordinary rental property in the City and is not limited to a class that assessor data cannot identify. The code text of LAMC 47.06-47.07 is not in the corpus and should be checked for any coverage limits.
